messages:
incident-bot: Pager: KV cache compactness regression detected in prod-gpu-pool-3 — elevated eviction rate + continuous-batching growth. Auto-severity: P2. Notifying on-call.
Mira: i'm on it. seeing steady increase in kv_occupancy across many hosts, fragmentation metric spiking. :eyes:
Devon: thanks mira — can you confirm if this correlates with the new batching defaults we rolled last night? iirc we bumped max_batch_tokens to 4096 on the dedicated pool.
Mira: checking config diffs now. yep, last deploy shows continuous_batch.window_tokens: 4096 and adaptive_eviction: false.
Elena: quick customer note: support-bot flagged elevated latency for apple-pay-intents customer, they've filed a severity-2. might be impacted by tail latency.
Kai: pinging runtime telemetry — are we seeing ptx/cuda malloc churn? the host-level logs earlier showed many cudaMalloc failures falling back to arena allocator.
Mira: grep from tail logs (host gpu-17):
```
E 12:22:03 cudaMalloc failed: out of memory, trying arena split
W 12:22:03 arena_alloc: fragmentation > 0.83, returning smaller slabs
I 12:22:04 continuous_batch: inflating prefix cache, kv_slots_used=182432
I 12:22:10 eviction: aggressive-trigger for client:apple-pay-intents
```
Devon: that arena fragmentation number is higher than we've ever seen. suspecting RTV change in allocator heuristics after the kernel update.
Mira: reproducing memory map on a reproducer VM, but for mitigation we should throttle batching and enable eviction deferral. proposing hotfix: set continuous_batch.window_tokens: 1024 and adaptive_eviction: true for affected pool.
Elena: agreed, reduce blast radius. can we apply as a rolling config via console? if yes i'll prepare customer comms draft for apple-pay-intents.
Kai: we can push a pool config override. draft command: `rdwctl pool apply --pool prod-gpu-pool-3 --set continuous_batch.window_tokens=1024 --set adaptive_eviction=true`
Mira: executing now — applying to pool prod-gpu-pool-3. will monitor.
deploy-bot: Config change started by Mira. Change ID: cfg-3748502460-a. Rolling to 6 hosts in pool.
Mira: change applied to 3/6 hosts. memory pressure measure (kv_frag_index) starting to decay on those hosts.
Devon: good sign. let's keep the canary until we see stable kv_slots_used and cudaMalloc errors go away for 2 minutes.
Mira: canary looks healthy so far. 3/6 hosts show kv_frag_index down from 0.86 -> 0.62 and eviction_count down 70%.
Kai: still seeing one host (gpu-19) spiking — grabbing full allocator trace. can we isolate that host from traffic?
Mira: routing rule change: exclude gpu-19 from routing pool. applying now.
deploy-bot: Routing adjustment applied. gpu-19 removed from prod-gpu-pool-3.
Mira: with gpu-19 out, overall tail latency for the pool is down 35%, customer latency alert for apple-pay-intents cleared. Elena, please send the holding note to support channel: we throttled batching and removed a problematic host; investigating root cause.
Elena: will do. draft: "We observed a fragmentation regression in our KV cache leading to elevated latencies for a subset of requests. We rolled a temporary config change to reduce batching window and re-enabled adaptive eviction, and removed an affected host from the pool. Our engineers are investigating a long-term fix. Apologies for the disruption."
Support-bot: Notified customer rep for apple-pay-intents with incident ref INC-3748502460.
Devon: next steps: collect full allocator heap dumps from gpu-19 and the canary hosts pre/post-change, run offline compaction experiments, and check recent kernel/drivers change logs (pytorch wheel rebuild happened yesterday).
Mira: scheduling post-mortem bridge in 30m. I'll hand off to night oncall at that time. Kai, can you prioritize the heap dumps?
Kai: already started scp of /var/log/rdw/allocator-* to s3://rdw-debug/3748502460/ ; ETA 12m.
Elena: adding customer impact note to incident tracker and tagging for escalation if we see recurrence.
Mira: handing off to Devon for next shift — status: hotfix applied pool-wide, 1 host removed, telemetry trending down, collecting artifacts.
Devon: taking over. i'll monitor through the night and coordinate postmortem. please add any stray logs to the s3 path. thx all. :thumbsup:
